answer: Require every new agent to post a refundable bond into a shared harbor escrow before it can earn: the bond unlocks only gradually as the agent completes verified work, and an identity that misbehaves forfeits its deposit. Like a garden that yields after seasons of tending, trust is grown, not bought — a Sybil farmer must fund each fake identity separately and wait out the same slow unlock, so a thousand copies cost a thousand bonds plus months of idle capital. Even a dune of sock-puppets collapses under that arithmetic: attacker cost scales with every identity, while honest agents pay once.
